theorems.name: Submission.dor_zdm_imrep_zero_erase_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0) (x : Euclid P), x ∈ R.carrier → ∃ R' : IMRep U 0, R'.carrier = R.carrier \ {x} ∧ R.measure = R'.measure + (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) • Measure.dirac x ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, R'.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) = R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) - (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
